text: Seems very promising, I like the overall feel of the world and theme. There are some kinks, especially with the tekst boxes, it feels like english is not the native language of the developer. But it's a minor thing, and doesn't really affect the "gameplay". I'll give a review later when I've had more time to test it out 😊
author: Aya Kamille Ogilvie Hviid

text: Having now bought access to the full app I am completely satisfied with the product. I have ADHD and have problems motivating my self to do stuff. This app have me looking for projects! Downside is I almost want to cheat XD "Hack": With "before bedtime activities" you want points for, but your phone shouldn't be near you at that time, put the habits in as "did I do X yesterday?" It gives me a morning routine and beginning the day on a positive note reminding me I did good yesterday ^^'
author: Anne Christine Tvilum Erichsen (AC)
